acceptance: Unregistered shipped templates are labelled unmeasured.
Labels match by content hash; a renamed copy with edits is not labelled as the shipped template.
Managed-cloud runs can carry a measured state.
context: Found 2026-10-13 by an adversarial review of d33acc8f1 (#2875) at origin/develop 77048bfb9.
description:
## Problem
- **Fails open.** An unregistered shipped template returns None from `benchbox/core/tuning/template_evidence.py:113-115` instead of "unmeasured". The tuned SSB Snowflake bundle from 2026-10-12 has no `template_evidence` for this reason.
- **Managed-cloud runs can never be measured.** `_memory_scope` (`:73-78`) gives them no measured state.
- **Matches by file name.** Labels attach by file name, so any user file named `tpch_tuned.yaml` inherits the shipped template's label.
- **Misleading wording.** "has no measured benefit" reads like a measured null result.

## Change
- Return "unmeasured" for unregistered shipped paths.
- Match on a content hash.
- Allow a measured state for managed-cloud scopes.
- Reword the warning to "benefit not yet measured".
